newsitem.title: JORDAN: Three die in Jordanian floods.
newsitem.headline: Three die in Jordanian floods.

text.p: Two Jordanians and a Dutch tourist have died in flash floods in southern Jordan, state television reported on Tuesday.
It said they were killed after heavy rain on Monday night which caused landslides and heavy damage to roads and communications in the town of Wadi Musa.
Wadi Musa is about 10 miles (16 km) from the ancient Nabatean city of Petra, a popular tourist site.
The television did not name the Dutch tourist.
